newsitem.title: KENYA: Prices mixed, demand strong at Kenya auction.
newsitem.headline: Prices mixed, demand strong at Kenya auction.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed in strong demand at the weekly Kenyan export auction in Mombasa, traders said.
They said brighter BP1s met good competition and rose by up to six U.S. cents while coloury mediums were firm to four cents up. Lower mediums and plainer grades fell by one to four cents.

Brightest PF1s rose five cents, all others were firm to four up with plainer sorts discounted by up to three cents. Brightest PDusts gained up to six with other brighter sorts firm to three dearer. Mediums, lower mediums and plainer sorts were about steady. Pakistan and Egypt were the main buyers.
